label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler Eyeing Three-Peat
items.text: Scottie Scheffler aims to join Tiger Woods as the only three-peat leader at the Memorial Tournament, while Rory McIlroy seeks his first leader’s handshake from Jack Nicklaus at Muirfield Village.

items.headline: McIlroy Eyes US Open Conditions
items.text: Rory McIlroy noted Shinnecock Hills’ fairways are generous but the rough penalizes misses heavily, expecting greens at about 11–11.2 speed as he prepares for the upcoming US Open.

items.headline: Tiger's GOAT Thoughts
items.text: Tiger Woods calls Jack Nicklaus “the greatest leader” but insiders believe Woods privately sees himself as the greatest player due to his major-winning margins and peak dominance.
